subject: Problem implementing Preacher et al conditional effects model 5

messages.author: 49b3c132465ab0b3
messages.subject: Problem implementing Preacher et al conditional effects model 5
parts:
Can anyone help?

I have checked and checked and the variables are fine, but I keep getting this error message whenever I try to run the model:

Error in lav_partable_constraints_def(lavpartable, con = NULL, debug = debug) : 
  lavaan ERROR: unknown label(s) in variable definitions: CastillianY PIVOxEUS

Here is the exact code I use:

# Effect coding Castillian/Euskera (-1: Euskera, 1: Castillian)
data$CastillianY[data$CastillianY<1]<--1

summary(data$CastillianY)

# Computing interactions of IV and MV with moderator CastillianY

data$sdoxEUS<-(data$SSDO*data$CastillianY)
summary(data$sdoxEUS)

data$PIVOxEUS<-(data$PIVO*data$CastillianY)
summary(data$PIVOxEUS)

model1 <- '# Direct effects
autonVASscale ~ c1*SSDO
autonVASscale ~ c2*CastillianY
autonVASscale ~ c3*sdoxEUS
# Mediator
PIVO ~ a1*SSDO
PIVO ~ a2*CastillianY
PIVO ~ a3*sdoxEUS
autonVASscale ~ b1*PIVO
autonVASscale ~ b2*PIVOxEUS
# Conditional Effect of SSDO on PIVO 
# for Euskera v Castillian
CESDOPIVO:=a1+a3*CastillianY
# Conditional effect of PIVO on autonVASscale 
# for euskera v castillian
CEPIVOauton:=b1+b2*CastillianY
# Conditional Indirect Effect of SSDO on autonVASscale
# for euskera v castillian
CIESDOauton1 := a1*(b1+b2*PIVOxEUS)
CIESDOauton2 := b1*(a1+a3*PIVOxEUS)
# Conditional Direct Effect of SSDO on autonVASscale
# for euskera v castillian
CDSDOauton := c1+c3
# Indirect Effect of Highest Order Interaction
IE_HiOrd_Intxn1 := a1*b2
IE_HiOrd_Intxn2 := b1*a3'

fit <- sem(model1, data = data, se = "bootstrap")
summary(fit)

Thank you!

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: Problem implementing Preacher et al conditional effects model 5
parts:
In the define ":=" operator, you need to put parameter labels, not variable names.

CESDOPIVO:=a1+a3*CastillianY

Castillany is variable name, not the parameter labels. I am not sure what you are trying to do here so I cannot have any further suggestions.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Problem implementing Preacher et al conditional effects model 5
parts: Thank you very much for your response! How do I look up the proper parameter labels to use then?

You don't have to look labels up.  You create labels, and they need to follow the same rules for naming any R object.  You can see instructions by reading the tutorials on the lavaan web site.

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax2.html
